plan: Define Workspace class with __init__ deep-copying data and validating structure.
Implement helper methods for finding items, validating containers, and computing word counts.
Implement total_word_count recursively summing note text words and reference word_count.
Implement unresolved_markers by scanning note text for [[?identifier]] and sorting unique ids.
Implement outline recursively with indentation and kind: title lines.
Implement move with validation: ids exist, destination is container, index valid, no self/descendant move, then relocate item.
Implement to_data returning deep copy of internal data.
Ensure all errors raise ValueError and failed moves leave data unchanged.
mechanisms: Deep copy input data in __init__ to isolate internal state.
Recursive traversal functions for word count, markers, outline, and item lookup.
Validation checks before any mutation in move.
Use of list operations to remove and insert items preserving order.
